answer: Each agent identity is bound to a TPM/SGX enclave, which produces a zero-knowledge attestation of measured code and a VDF-sequenced key rotation. The sparrow state tree commits attestations; the garden consensus contract verifies proofs, while marble is the immutable hash anchor. Forging identities requires compromising distinct hardware or continuously provisioning silicon; admission bonds follow an O(N^2) curve, and failed proofs slash collateral irreversibly.
